verses.english: “There are these two kinds of inclusion.
Inclusion in things of the flesh and inclusion in the teaching.
These are the two kinds of inclusion.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ dvinnaṁ saṅgahānaṁ yadidaṁ dhammasaṅgaho”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two kinds of inclusion is inclusion in the teaching.”
